in_sanskrit.name: Monaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon god
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'moonā', meaning 'moon' or 'monkey god Hanuman'. In Hindu mythology, Monaj represents the divine power and strength of Hanuman, who is a revered figure known for his devotion and unwavering loyalty.
